    • 9:20 a.m. – 7 p.m.: Featured Groups (Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, Masters.com)
    • 11:15 a.m. – 6 p.m.: Amen Corner (Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, Masters.com)
    • 12 p.m. – 2 p.m.: Early Round 4 Coverage (Paramount+)
    • 2 p.m. – 7 p.m.:
      Main Broadcast (CBS, Paramount+, or via FuboTV)
